clarity.notes: Each screen answers one question: what's this week / what should I study next / what's on the calendar. Coaching headline on dashboard states the two most urgent items.

hierarchy.notes: One landing point per screen — week strip, mastery ring + suggested-next pair, month grid. Rails stay secondary via smaller type and muted color.

typography.notes: Avenir Next display over system body, caps tracking 0.06–0.08em, tabular numerals on all data, 11px caption floor.

motion.notes: One flourish: mastery ring + KC bars ease in on load. Everything else is 150ms state transitions; all gated behind prefers-reduced-motion.

brand.notes: Minimal-motivational: near-white canvas, single teal-green growth accent reserved for progress and primary actions, four muted course hues doing functional calendar coding only.
